sources.title: Gemma 4 - Axolotl
sources.snippet: LoRA kernels: Not supported for models with KV-sharing layers. lora_target_linear: Incompatible for multimodal models; use lora_target_modules with a regex to restrict LoRA to the text backbone. TIPS Gradient spikes: Gemma 4's text attention uses scaling=1.0 with QK-RMSNorm, leaving the softmax structurally near-saturated.
